name: 01_intake_fitting_overhead
setup: for (const c of g.rig.circuits.keys()) g.rig.setCircuit(c, true); g.world.goto('intake'); g.look(-21, 0, 26.0, Math.PI, 0.30); if (g.flashlight) { g.flashlight.isOn = false; g.flashlight.on = false; }

name: 02_intake_corridor
setup: const r = g.world.goto('intake'); const p = (r && r.position) || g.world.spawn; g.lookOpen(p, (r && r.yaw) || 0, 0); if (g.flashlight) { g.flashlight.isOn = false; g.flashlight.on = false; }

name: 03_intake_ceiling_up
setup: g.world.goto('intake'); g.look(-21, 0, 29.4, 0, 0.95); if (g.flashlight) { g.flashlight.isOn = false; g.flashlight.on = false; }
